name: Runway
tagline: Generative video and creative AI tools for images, video, and editing

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Standard plan listed at $15/month monthly and $12/month annually in public pricing references.

verdictSummary: A UI around video models is buildable; the video-generation model quality, compute, safety, editing stack, and continuous research are not a solo afternoon project.
coreLoopDIY: Wrap open-source/video APIs to generate or edit clips, manage credits, and export assets.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because generative video quality and inference infrastructure are the product.

priorArt.name: diffusers
priorArt.desc: Open-source library for diffusion models; useful for experimentation, not a Runway replace

alternatives.name: ComfyUI
alternatives.desc: Images, video, masking, upscaling and effects in one graph; it replaces tools, not Runway's polish.

alternatives.name: Draw Things
alternatives.desc: Local image and video generation on Apple hardware; a creator suite only if your editor lives elsewhere.

alternatives.name: LTX Desktop
alternatives.desc: The closest free thing to a generative video suite: local models, retakes and an actual editing timeline.

alternatives.name: NodeTool
alternatives.desc: The rare open app with model workflows, masking and a video timeline; no included cloud render farm.

alternatives.name: SwarmUI
alternatives.desc: A friendlier shell around local image and video workflows; editing remains thinner than Runway's.

alternatives.name: WanGP
alternatives.desc: A broad local image-and-video workbench; generation is free, the proprietary Runway models are not included.

notes: Important no for the frontier-model category.
prompt:
Build me a thin video-generation workbench over hosted models, in place of
Runway. Requirements:

- A local web page on localhost:3300: Node + Express, a prompt box, a model
  picker, and a gallery of past generations.
- Generate via the Replicate API (token in .env) against current open video
  models (Wan/LTX/Hunyuan class). Pick one provider and stick to it; fal.ai
  only if it has a model Replicate lacks.
- Poll the job, download the mp4 to ~/generations/YYYY-MM-DD/, and record
  prompt, model, params, cost, and file path in SQLite (better-sqlite3).
- Image-to-video: upload a still and pass it as the conditioning frame.
- Show a month-to-date spend total computed from per-job cost so usage stays
  honest.
- No accounts, no telemetry; prompts and outputs stay local except the API
  calls themselves.
- Out of scope: editing timelines, inpainting, and anything realtime. Do not
  build model hosting or a job queue beyond simple polling.
- README: where to get the Replicate token, rough dollars per second of video
  on the default model, and a note that this rents models rather than replacing
  Runway, whose frontier video models and compute cannot be rebuilt solo.
